verdict.rationale: Folk's own integrations page lists prebuilt connectors you can turn on, including Google contacts sync, conversation and contact import, one-click LinkedIn imports and Gmail sync, so a catalog of first-party integrations exists. However, none of the categories named in the story appear: there is no evidence for Slack, support desk, marketing or data warehouse integrations, and nothing describing a browsable app marketplace with an install flow. Missing for 10: Slack integration, support-desk integration, marketing-tool integration, data-warehouse integration, documented marketplace/install experience, independent corroboration.
